env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

# A write through a copy or alias of a const composite map field fails with the rule ID,
# whichever file sorts first.
cd m
cp a.lgo $WORK/order-positive.lgo
cp ../order-alias-attacks.lgo a.lgo
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/order-alias-attack$GOEXE .
stderr -count=4 '\[correctness::const_view_mutation\]'
! logos eject -o $WORK/order-alias-out
stderr -count=4 '\[correctness::const_view_mutation\]'
cp $WORK/order-positive.lgo a.lgo

# A use that sorts before the defining file reads the same const composite.
logos run .
cmp stdout want.txt
logos eject -o out
cd out
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout ../want.txt
cd ../..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ccorder

go 1.27

-- m/want.txt --
ok exported-read 1
ok exported-copy-detached 7 9
ok exported-alias-read 2
ok unexported-read 1
ok unexported-copy-detached 7 9
ok unexported-alias-read 2
ok scalar 7
-- m/a.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("ok exported-read", Cfg.M["a"] ?? -1)
	c := Cfg
	c.N = 9
	fmt.Println("ok exported-copy-detached", Cfg.N, c.N)
	m := Cfg.M
	fmt.Println("ok exported-alias-read", m["b"] ?? -1)
	fmt.Println("ok unexported-read", cfg.M["a"] ?? -1)
	d := cfg
	d.N = 9
	fmt.Println("ok unexported-copy-detached", cfg.N, d.N)
	n := cfg.M
	fmt.Println("ok unexported-alias-read", n["b"] ?? -1)
	fmt.Println("ok scalar", cfg.N)
}
-- m/b.lgo --
package main

type box struct {
	M map[string]int
	N int
}

const Cfg = box{M: map[string]int{"a": 1, "b": 2}, N: 7}

const cfg = box{M: map[string]int{"a": 1, "b": 2}, N: 7}
-- order-alias-attacks.lgo --
package main

func main() {
	c := Cfg
	c.M["a"] = 9
	m := Cfg.M
	m["b"] = 77
	d := cfg
	d.M["a"] = 9
	n := cfg.M
	n["b"] = 77
}
